headline: octet/Pi full_ui_s ratio per leg (cold, warm); lower is better, below 1.0 means octet is faster than Pi
metrics_md:
- `full_ui_s`: Seconds from process spawn until PI-EVAL-READY is on screen (every configured extension live, session_start delivered). (lower is better)
- `typeable_s`: Seconds from spawn until the editor is usable (octet: composer/model label; Pi: footer model label). (lower is better)
- `packages_parity`: Fraction of locked packages whose load status (loaded / not loaded) matches Pi 1.4.0. (higher is better)
- `command_parity`: Jaccard similarity of extension slash-command names against Pi 1.4.0. (higher is better)
- `clean_exit`: 1 when Ctrl+D exits with code 0 within the grace period and the terminal modes are restored. (higher is better)
